$comment: Repo-owned build hints. NOT exported from Figma, and deliberately kept out
of src/figma/*.json so a re-export cannot wipe them.
Figma has no concept of 'this number is a count, not a length'. Every FLOAT
looks the same to the export, so anything the build must treat differently
is recorded here by token path.
Add to this file, never to src/figma/.

unitless.$comment: FLOAT tokens that must NOT get a px suffix in CSS.
